I notice SQLite disables foreign_keys enforcement, so the cascade wouldn't actually fire there—memo_share rows get orphaned on SQLite but properly cascaded on Postgres/MySQL. So the directly affected tables are memo_relation, attachment, and memo through explicit Go cleanup code, plus memo_share via database-level FK cascade on the databases that enforce it. I want to verify whether memo_share deletion is also handled explicitly in the Go code anywhere.

I searched for DeleteMemoShare calls and confirmed there's no such cleanup in the DeleteMemo path—only relations and attachments are handled explicitly. Reaction rows also aren't deleted anywhere.
